text:
No tree-cover loss event of **0.5 hectares or more** was detected on the property between 2021 and 2025. The satellite data did identify **0.4 hectares of loss in smaller patches in 2021**, below the event threshold.

The assessment covered the whole property, but small changes, changes at boundaries, or features narrower than the 30-metre satellite pixels may have been missed. It does not establish regulatory compliance or address changes after 2025.
